activities.title: Chat-Back Babble
activities.steps: Copy baby's sounds back. Wait. Smile. Say the real word too: "ba-ba — ball!"

activities.title: Name Everything Walk
activities.steps: Walk slowly. Point and name: "tree… leaf… dog." Pause often. Baby listens to real words about real things.

activities.title: Sound Shakers
activities.steps: Put rice in one, pasta in the other, seal tight. Shake yours, pause, let baby shake. Different sounds, same game.
activities.warning: Seal lids firmly; check before each use

activities.title: Board Book Basket
activities.steps: Put books in a basket on the floor. Baby chooses and mouths/explores. Read the chosen one slowly, pointing at pictures.

activities.title: Action Song Time
activities.steps: Sing "Heads and Shoulders" / "Incy Wincy" with actions. Do baby's hands/feet gently with the words. Same songs daily — rhythm is the lesson.

activities.title: Songs in Another Language

materials.name: A carer who knows the language

activities.steps: If the carer speaks another language, sing one lullaby or counting song in it every day. Babies soak up sounds long before words.

activities.title: Treasure Basket

materials.name: wooden spoon, silk scarf, pine cone, metal cup, soft brush

activities.steps: Sit baby with the basket. Let them pick up, mouth and drop each treasure. You just watch, name things softly, stay close.
activities.warning: All items big, clean, nothing breakable

activities.title: Crinkle & Jingle Play Mat

materials.name: Crinkle toy or clean baking paper

activities.steps: Lay baby on the mat. Crinkle paper near their feet to kick at. Jingle softly left, then right — baby turns toward sound.

activities.title: Kitchen Drum Band
activities.steps: Bang a slow beat. Stop. Wait for baby. Copy any sound baby makes. Call and answer, like a tiny conversation.

activities.title: Reach & Grab Mobile

materials.name: Play gym or ribbon + soft toy

activities.steps: Hang one soft toy just within reach. Move it a little each day. Celebrate every grab.

activities.title: Drop It In the Pot
activities.steps: Show: ball in pot, lid on, shake! Tip out, repeat. Older babies will do the dropping themselves — endlessly.
activities.warning: Balls too big to fit in a mouth

activities.title: Sticky Tape Rescue
activities.steps: Tape toys lightly to a tray. Baby peels and rescues them. Peeling = strong little fingers.

activities.title: Tummy Time Trail
activities.steps: Short, often, always supervised. Put the mirror/toy just ahead. Get down at baby's level and cheer.

activities.title: Cushion Mountain
activities.steps: Build a soft low mountain for crawlers. Stay right beside. Climbing over = legs, arms and problem-solving.

activities.title: Tunnel Crawl

materials.name: Play tunnel or big cardboard box

activities.steps: Peek from the other end. Roll a ball through. Crawling through again and again builds strength and courage.

activities.title: Black & White Cards
activities.steps: Prop a card 20–30 cm from baby's face at tummy time. Swap patterns every few days. Watch those eyes track.

activities.title: Colour Kite Watching

materials.name: Bright silk scarf or ribbon wand

activities.steps: Float the scarf slowly above baby, like a kite. Name the colour as it drifts. Gentle, slow, calm.

activities.title: One Colour Day — Red

materials.name: Red things from home: cup, ball, cloth, apple

activities.steps: Gather safe red things in one spot. Explore them together all day. "Red" said often, in real life — no drilling.

activities.title: Splash Bowl
activities.steps: On the floor or in the bath. Hands in, splash together. Add a sponge to squeeze. Never leave baby alone near water — not for a second.

activities.title: Texture Squares

materials.name: Squares of safe fabrics: corduroy, silk, felt, towelling

activities.steps: Lay squares out. Rub baby's hand gently over each. Name the feeling: "soft… bumpy… smooth."

activities.title: Frozen Flower Tray
activities.steps: Freeze petals in a shallow tray of water. Baby touches the cold, watches it melt, finds the flowers again.

activities.title: Peekaboo — Every Way
activities.steps: Hide, pop out, big smile. Baby learns: you go, and you always come back. That trust is the lesson.

activities.title: Mirror Faces
activities.steps: Faces together in the mirror: happy, surprised, sleepy. Name them. Baby copies — that's empathy starting.

activities.title: Calm-Down Cuddle Corner
activities.steps: Same cosy spot, same soft song when baby is overwhelmed. Rock, hum, breathe slow. Rhythm = safety at this age.

activities.title: Tell Me the Story Back
activities.steps: Read a loved book. Next read, pause before the fun word — let them fill it. Then "what happened next?" Their version counts.

activities.title: Puppet Chats
activities.steps: Your puppet asks theirs questions: name, favourite food, who is at home. Shy talkers often chat freely through a puppet.

activities.title: Shopkeeper Talk
activities.steps: Set up a shop. "Hello! I would like apples, please." Swap roles. Real sentences grow inside real games.

activities.title: Sand Tray Letters
activities.steps: Spread sand thin. Trace the first letter of their name. Say the sound: "sss — Sam." Shake to erase, go again.

activities.title: Letter Hunt in the House
activities.steps: Stick 4–5 letters around the room (start with their name letter). "Can you find B?" Every find gets a happy dance.

activities.title: My Name in Playdough
activities.steps: Roll dough sausages, bend them into the letters of their name on the card. Squash, roll, repeat — fingers get writing-strong.

activities.title: Counting the Snack
activities.steps: Count pieces onto the plate together, touching each one: "1… 2… 3!" Then eat the maths. Works at every snack.

activities.title: Sort It! Socks & Lids

materials.name: Mixed socks, jar lids, big buttons

activities.steps: Tip them out. Sort by colour, then by size. Ask "where does this one live?" Sorting is early maths in disguise.

activities.title: Stair Counting & Teddy Steps
activities.steps: Count every step out loud, up and down. Teddy "jumps" the number you call. Numbers + bodies learn together.

activities.title: Sort the Rainbow Pom-Poms
activities.steps: Put one pom-pom in each colour spot, saying the colour. Then tip out and let them sort. Tongs make little hands strong.

activities.title: Colour Walk
activities.steps: Pick ONE colour card. Walk and hunt for matches: "a GREEN leaf! GREEN grass!" One colour per walk keeps it winnable.

activities.title: Shape Sandwiches
activities.steps: Carer cuts triangle, square, circle sandwiches. Child names, matches to a shape card, then eats the shapes.

activities.title: Hello Song in Two Languages

materials.name: A carer who knows the language

activities.steps: Start each day with hello in both languages, same tune, with a wave. Add goodbye. Routine makes it effortless.

activities.title: Counting Hopscotch — in Spanish (or carer's language)
activities.steps: Chalk 1–5 squares. Jump and count in the other language: "¡uno, dos, tres!" Bodies remember words.

activities.title: Picture Word Cards — Two Words Each
activities.steps: Show a card. Say both words: "dog — perro." Child repeats the one they like. Five cards max per game.

activities.title: Sink or Float?
activities.steps: Guess first: "float or sink?" Drop it in. Cheer either way. Guessing + testing = the scientific method, toddler edition.

activities.title: Ice Rescue Mission

materials.name: Toy animals frozen in a tub of ice

activities.steps: Freeze small toys in water overnight. Child rescues them with warm water and spoons. Melting, patience, hero feelings.

activities.title: Grow a Bean in a Cup
activities.steps: Wet cotton in the cup, tuck the bean by the side so roots show. Water daily together. Watch, wonder, wait.

activities.title: Finger Paint Garden
activities.steps: Paint with fingers and whole hands. Stems first (you model), then they add "flowers" with fist prints. Process over pretty.

activities.title: Sticker Story
activities.steps: Child sticks a scene, then tells you the story of it. You write their exact words under it. First "published" book!

activities.title: Dress-Up Day — Who Am I?

materials.name: Dress-up box: hats, scarves, old clothes

activities.steps: Both dress up. Stay in character: doctors, bakers, firefighters. Pretend play is vocabulary + empathy training.

activities.title: Freeze Dance
activities.steps: Dance while music plays. Freeze when it stops! Listening, body control and giggles in one game.

activities.title: Rhyme Time Basket
activities.steps: Same 3 rhymes all week, with actions. By Friday, pause before the rhyming word — they will shout it.

activities.title: Make a Shaker Band
activities.steps: Fill bottles with different things, seal, decorate. Then: band practice! Loud, soft, fast, slow — first music words.

activities.title: Pouring Station
activities.steps: Show slow, two hands. Pour jug to jug on the tray. Spills? Sponge is part of the activity — wiping is learning too.

activities.title: Big Buttons & Zips Board

materials.name: Dressing frame or old shirt with big buttons

activities.steps: Practise on the clothes, not in the morning rush. Start the zip/button, let them finish. Cheer the last bit loudest.

activities.title: Obstacle Course — Backyard GP
activities.steps: Build: crawl under, balance on the line, throw the ball in the bucket. Time it with cheers, never pressure.

activities.title: What Happens Next?
activities.steps: Stop before a page turn: "what do you think happens next?" Predicting is comprehension — the heart of reading.

activities.title: Story Stones
activities.steps: Paint a simple picture on each stone (sun, house, dog, star). Child pulls 3 stones and invents the story. You write it down.

activities.title: Interview a Grown-Up
activities.steps: Child interviews you (or a grandparent on a call): 3 questions they choose. Big talking, listening and memory.

activities.title: Sandpaper Letter Tracing

materials.name: Sandpaper letters (buy or DIY: card + fine sandpaper )

activities.steps: Trace the letter with two fingers, saying the SOUND ("buh"), not the name. 3 letters at a time. Their fingers remember.

activities.title: Name Writing — Everywhere
activities.steps: Name on their artwork, in chalk outside, with sticks at the park. Same name, many ways — writing becomes theirs.

activities.title: Sound Scavenger Hunt
activities.steps: "Find me things that start with sss…" Snake-sound hunting makes letter sounds a game, not a lesson.

activities.title: Write the Shopping List (Together)
activities.steps: You write the real list; they "write" theirs beside you — scribbles and first letters welcome. Writing with a real job to do.

activities.title: Baking Maths
activities.steps: Count spoonfuls together, measure the flour, set the timer. Real maths you can eat. (Raising Children lists cooking as a top counting activity.)

activities.title: Pattern Beading
activities.steps: Start a pattern: red-red-blue… child continues it. Patterns are the roots of maths AND music.

activities.title: Snakes & Ladders / Go Fish
activities.steps: Count spaces aloud, read the dice, match numbers in Go Fish. Losing gracefully is part of the curriculum at 5.

activities.title: Count & Colour in Two Languages
activities.steps: Count blocks 1–10 in English, then in the carer's language. Name each block's colour in both. Two games in one.

activities.title: Song of the Week (Other Language)

materials.name: A carer who knows the song

activities.steps: One song, sung daily for a week — "Frère Jacques" style. By Friday they're singing it in the bath.

activities.title: Please & Thank You — Role Play
activities.steps: Run a pretend café where orders happen in the other language: hello, please, thank you, one juice. Manners in two tongues.

activities.title: Volcano in the Sandpit
activities.steps: Bury a cup in sand, add bicarb + colour, pour vinegar — ERUPTION. Ask first: "what do you think will happen?"

activities.title: Nature Treasure Hunt

materials.name: Picture list (leaf, feather, smooth stone, seed)

activities.steps: Hunt with the picture list in a park or garden. Tick each find. Sort treasures at home: rough/smooth, big/small.

activities.title: Magnets — Magic or Science?
activities.steps: Predict each object, then test. Sort into "sticks / doesn't stick". A first real experiment with a chart.

activities.title: Weather Watcher
activities.steps: Every morning: look outside, draw/stick today's weather. After a month, count the sunny days together.

activities.title: Colour Mixing Lab
activities.steps: Mix two colours in water, guess first. Paint with the new colour. Science wearing an art smock — colours learned for real.

activities.title: Collage — My Family
activities.steps: Cut and glue a picture of their family (pets too). Scissors + glue = fine motor gold. They narrate who's who.

activities.title: Cardboard City
activities.steps: Build a city over 2–3 days: houses, roads, a shop. Projects that grow teach planning like nothing else.

activities.title: Leaf Rubbing Gallery
activities.steps: Leaf under paper, rub crayon sideways — the veins appear like magic. Name the trees if you can. Frame the best one.

activities.title: Copy My Rhythm
activities.steps: Clap a pattern: clap-clap-STOMP. They copy. Then they lead. Rhythm patterns = maths patterns in the body.

activities.title: Animal Moves Dance
activities.steps: Pull a card, dance like that animal to the music. Kangaroo hops, snake slides. Silly is the point.

activities.title: Make a Real Instrument — Rainstick
activities.steps: Seal one end, add rice, seal, decorate. Tip it slow — rain! Play along with a song together.

activities.title: Little Chef — Real Job
activities.steps: Give a REAL job: peel, slice the banana, stir. Real tools, real trust, real pride. Cook together weekly if the family loves it.

activities.title: Scissor Skills Path
activities.steps: Snip strips first, then lines, then shapes. Thumbs up, elbows in. A skill path they can see themselves climbing.

activities.title: Balance & Jump Circuit
activities.steps: Walk the line, jump the cushions, hop in the hoop. Add one harder bit each week. Strong, brave, coordinated.

activities.title: Feelings Faces Game
activities.steps: Pull a card, make the face, guess it. Then: "when did YOU feel like that?" Naming feelings tames them.

activities.title: Puppet Problem Solvers
activities.steps: Act a small problem: both puppets want the same truck. Pause. "What could they do?" The child directs the fix.

activities.title: Helping Hands Job Chart
activities.steps: Pick one real helping job a day: water plants, feed the pet, set the table. Sticker when done. Contributing feels good (EYLF Outcome 2).

activities.title: Narrate It Back

materials.name: A "living book" — a real story book

activities.steps: Read one short chapter aloud. Child tells it back in their own words — all of it. Narration builds memory and comprehension better than quizzes.

activities.title: Reading Fort + Book Picnic
activities.steps: Build the fort together, picnic inside, read side by side. Cozy places make reading a treat, not a task.

activities.title: Comic Strip a Story
activities.steps: Retell a known story as a comic: beginning, middle, end ×2. Drawing the sequence IS comprehension practice.

activities.title: Word Detective
activities.steps: Hunt for this week's spelling words or "wow words" in real books. Stick a note on each find. Words live in books, not lists.

activities.title: Copywork — One Beautiful Sentence
activities.steps: Child picks one great sentence and copies it slowly, best writing. Spelling, punctuation and handwriting in 5 honest minutes.

activities.title: Post a Real Letter
activities.steps: Write to grandma/cousin/friend, address it, walk to the post box. Writing with a destination beats any worksheet.

activities.title: Story Dice Writing

materials.name: Story dice or 3 dice + picture list

activities.steps: Roll a hero, a place, a problem. Write (or dictate) the story. Silly combinations unlock reluctant writers.

activities.title: Real Money Shop
activities.steps: You shop, they run the till: add prices, give change. Swap roles. Money maths with real stakes (pretend ones).

activities.title: Kitchen Measuring Challenge
activities.steps: They measure everything: grams, cups, halves. Double the recipe for a real challenge. Then eat the results.

activities.title: Time Bingo
activities.steps: Call a time ("half past three!"), they set the clock or find it on their card. Telling time becomes a game with a winner.

activities.title: Card Game Maths — Make 10 / War
activities.steps: "Make 10": flip pairs that add to 10. "War": bigger card wins, say the numbers. Fast, fun, endless number practice.

activities.title: Simon Says — in the Other Language

materials.name: A carer who knows the language

activities.steps: Body-part and action commands in the other language only. Listening comprehension disguised as the best game ever.

activities.title: Label the House
activities.steps: Label 10 things at home in the other language (door, table, dog…). Words in context, seen daily — they just absorb them.

activities.title: Café Role Play — Full Phrases
activities.steps: Whole café conversation in the other language: greeting, order, please/thank you, goodbye. Real phrases they'll keep for life.

activities.title: Nature Journal
activities.steps: Same tree/bird/plant each week. Draw it, date it, one sentence. A year of seasons in one book — treasure forever.

activities.title: Ramp Racers — Speed Science
activities.steps: Build ramps of different heights. Predict, race, measure. Change one thing at a time — that's real experiment design.

activities.title: Grow & Graph a Plant
activities.steps: Plant, water, measure weekly, draw the growth on a chart. Science + maths + patience in one pot.

activities.title: Bug Hotel Build
activities.steps: Build a layered bug hotel for the garden. Check weekly for guests. Caring for tiny creatures = EYLF Outcome 2 in action.

activities.title: First Sewing — Felt Friend
activities.steps: Draw a simple shape, cut two, stitch around, stuff, close. A made-by-me toy they'll keep. Handwork trains the will (Waldorf's words).

activities.title: Picture Study — Look Like an Artist
activities.steps: Look at the picture for 2 full minutes. Hide it — describe it. Look again. Then paint their own version of it.

activities.title: Build It Real — Birdhouse / Toolbox Project
activities.steps: Plan it (HighScope: plan first!), measure, build, sand, paint. Real tools with a close eye. Weeks of pride at the end.

activities.title: Composer of the Week
activities.steps: One composer/artist per week. Listen while drawing what the music "looks like". Music appreciation without a single test.

activities.title: Kitchen Band Recording
activities.steps: Practise a "song" together, record it, play it back like stars. Performing + listening back = real musicianship.

activities.title: Put On a Play
activities.steps: Retell a favourite story as a play for the family. Lines, costumes, a beginning and an end. Courage included free.

activities.title: Backyard Skills Ladder
activities.steps: Pick 3 skills (bounce-catch, hopscotch, skipping). Chart practice each week. Beating your own record beats beating others.

activities.title: Cook a Rainbow Dinner Helper
activities.steps: Plan a plate with 5 colours, wash, chop (soft veg), arrange. Eating the rainbow is health learning you can taste.

activities.title: Nature Scavenger Relay
activities.steps: Timed hunts in the park: something round, something rough, something that smells nice. Fast legs, sharp eyes.

activities.title: Team Build Challenge
activities.steps: With a sibling/friend (or carer): build "a bridge that holds the toy car" — together. Plan, jobs, negotiate. Review at the end: what worked?

activities.title: Feelings Weather Report
activities.steps: "What's your weather inside today — sunny, stormy, foggy?" Draw it. A daily 2-minute check-in that prevents big blow-ups.

activities.title: Kindness Mission
activities.steps: Make something for someone else: a card for a neighbour, biscuits for a friend. Giving is a skill — practise it.

activities.title: Deep Narration + One Question
activities.steps: Read a chapter. They retell it fully, then ask ONE question it raised. You wonder together — no googling for 5 minutes first.

activities.title: Two-Source Detective
activities.steps: Pick their question (why do volcanoes erupt?). Find two sources. Do they agree? Write what BOTH say. First media-literacy lesson.

activities.title: Book Club for Two
activities.steps: Read the same chapters during the week, then book-club: best scene, worst character decision, rating out of 10.

activities.title: Dictation Day

materials.name: A passage from a great book

activities.steps: Read a short passage slowly; they write it exactly. Spelling, punctuation and grammar absorbed from real writing — the classic Mason way.

activities.title: Comic Novel — Ongoing Series
activities.steps: One page per session of their own comic series: hero, world, cliffhanger. Story structure learned by living in it.

activities.title: Persuade Me — Speech in 3 Parts
activities.steps: Pick a cause (later bedtime? a pet?). Build: my point, 3 reasons, strong ending. Deliver it standing up. You may be persuaded.

activities.title: Family Newsletter Editor
activities.steps: They edit a weekly one-pager: news, a joke, a review, weather. Plan it, make it, send it to family. Real audience, real pride.

activities.title: Plan a Real Meal on a Budget
activities.steps: Budget: $30. They plan a family meal, price every item, stay under. Then cook it together. Fractions, totals, trade-offs — delicious.

activities.title: Fraction Kitchen
activities.steps: Halve it, quarter it, eighth it — then eat the fractions. Double a half-recipe. The tastiest fractions lesson there is.

activities.title: Strategy Games — Chess / Mastermind / Sudoku
activities.steps: Learn one strategy game properly. Play weekly, keep a score of best moves, not just wins. Logic is a muscle.

activities.title: Estimate Everything
activities.steps: Guess first, then measure/count: beans in the jar, steps to the park, pages in the book. Good estimators are good mathematicians.

activities.title: Conversation Café
activities.steps: 15 minutes, only the other language: order food, talk about the weekend, plan something. Mistakes welcome — bravery is the goal.

activities.title: Cook a Dish from That Country
activities.steps: Cook a real dish from the language's country. Learn the food words while your hands work. Culture you can eat.

activities.title: Song Translation Project

materials.name: A song they love in the other language

activities.steps: Translate one verse together, line by line. Sing it. Music makes vocabulary unforgettable.

activities.title: Fair Test Fridays
activities.steps: One question, written hypothesis, change ONE thing, record results in the lab book. A scientist's habits, built weekly.

activities.title: Citizen Science — Bird & Bug Counts
activities.steps: 20 minutes watching one spot. Count and draw every bird/bug. Real data, same place each week — seasons appear.

activities.title: Build a Circuit

materials.name: Snap-circuit kit or battery + LED + wires

activities.steps: Make a light turn on. Then a switch. Then a buzzer alarm for their bedroom door. Electricity understood by hand.

activities.title: Code a Tiny Game (Scratch)
activities.steps: Plan the game (HighScope plan-do-review), drag blocks, test, fix. Logic, patience and a game THEY made at the end.

activities.title: Sew Something Real — Cushion or Tote
activities.steps: Measure, cut, pin, stitch, finish. A useful thing they made themselves beats any decoration. Skills for life.

activities.title: Design & Build a Game
activities.steps: Invent a board/card game: rules, board, pieces. Playtest with the family, fix the unfair bits. Design = thinking.

activities.title: Artist Study — Copy the Master
activities.steps: Study one artist for a fortnight: look long, read their story, copy a work, then paint "in their style". Deep beats broad.

activities.title: Make a Stop-Motion Film
activities.steps: Storyboard 6 frames, shoot, edit, premiere for the family with popcorn. Planning + patience + storytelling in one project.

activities.title: Learn an Instrument — Practice Partner
activities.steps: You don't teach — you sit, listen, and keep the daily 15 minutes sacred. Sticker the chart. Audience = motivation.

activities.title: Ad-Busters — Read the Trick
activities.steps: Hunt ads together: what does it want you to feel? Who is it for? Then design an HONEST ad for something real at home.

activities.title: Plan the Adventure — Map a Hike
activities.steps: They plan the route, pack the list, lead the walk. You follow (with veto power on safety). Navigation + responsibility, live.

activities.title: Teach a Little Kid a Skill
activities.steps: They teach a younger sibling/neighbour one thing: tie laces, throw a ball, a card trick. Teaching is the deepest learning (and pure Montessori).

activities.title: Personal Best Training Plan
activities.steps: Pick a goal (run 1 km, 20 push-ups, skip 100). Plan 3 sessions a week, chart progress. Goal-setting they'll use forever.

activities.title: My Manifesto Poster
activities.steps: "Things I believe / things I'm good at / things I want to learn." Words + pictures, on the wall. Identity, made visible.

activities.title: Community Helper Project

materials.name: Gloves, bag (clean-up) or baking (for a neighbour)

activities.steps: Choose one real contribution: park clean-up, bake for a neighbour, help at the library. Plan it, do it, reflect after.

activities.title: Gratitude + Worry — Two Jars
activities.steps: One jar: one good thing daily. Other jar: worries go in, lid on, talked about Friday. Feelings managed with rituals, not lectures.
